title: Sim Racing Telemetry
description: A live dashboard for driving and race timing telemetry. Built for Gran Turismo 7.
note: Opens straight into a demo session. Live data needs a small bridge program (linked on the page) running on your own network.

cardImages.alt: Telemetry dashboard late in lap 3: lap and sector times, delta to best, speed, pedal trace and tyre temperatures
The same dashboard early in the lap, with the sector and lap table still filling in

title: Gran Turismo Tuner
description: Share Gran Turismo 7 tunes as a link. Pick a car, fill in the tune, and anyone who opens the link gets it in the same editable form.

cardImages.alt: Tune editor for an Alpine A110 '17 with sections for tires, suspension, differential, aerodynamics, brakes and engine tuning
Car picker with manufacturer Alpine and model A110 '17 selected

title: Valorant Team Randomizer
description: Rolls a unique agent for each of five players, with role minimums, per-player bans and a history that stops anyone getting stuck on one role.

cardImages.alt: The Team Randomiser after a roll: five agent cards, each showing a player's name and role, above the player list, the minimum-per-role rules and the roll history
A player's Bans picker with role buttons and a grid of agent portraits grouped by role, where two duelists are crossed out as banned
